content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on third-party platforms. This means that creators can maintain full control over their products and customer data, without having to worry about platform fees or restrictions. By using Cloudflare R2, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is tailored to their specific needs and goals.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Cloudflare R2 is designed to be highly scalable and performant, with a focus on security and reliability. By using Cloudflare Workers, creators can automate the delivery of their products, and with NOWPayments, they can accept cryptocurrency payments with a low fee of 0.5%. This means that creators can focus on producing high-quality products, without having to worry about the technical details of delivery and payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Cloudflare R2 is built for digital creators who want to maintain control over their products and customer data. This includes creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products. By using Cloudflare R2, these creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is tailored to their specific needs and goals, without having to rely on third-party platforms or pay high fees.
Cloudflare R2 provides a solution for digital product storage and delivery without Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2, creators can start by setting up a Cloudflare account and creating a new R2 bucket. They can then use Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of their products, and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. With Supabase, they can store customer data and order information, and use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get started with all the necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This allows them to maintain control over their products and customer data, while also avoiding high platform fees. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad (10%) and NOWPayments (0.5%) retains $921.
NOWPayments offers a low fee of 0.5% for cryptocurrency payments.

For creators who want to build a sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates. This kit includes everything needed to get started with Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, and can be purchased at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By using this kit, creators can deploy a seamless and efficient digital commerce stack, without having to rely on third-party platforms or pay high fees.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2, follow these steps: Set up a Cloudflare account and create a new R2 bucket. Use Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your products. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. Store customer data and order information using Supabase. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get started with all the necessary blueprints and templates. Purchase the kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and start building your sovereign digital commerce stack today.
